about: Owner-decided rules and guard limits for LUNAR: War Machines. ONLY an owner-decided prompt may change this file. dev/tests/owner-rules.mjs fails the build when the game code or a guard test drifts from it (a constant changes, a limit is loosened, a CP source or sink appears). Created by the Session 6B prompt (owner decision 9, Nov 16, 2026).

research.about: Owner decision 1 (Session 6B): research costs research parts and time only (no CP, alloy, biomass or helium); Worker clock I 20 min / II 2 h / III 8 h; one job at a time, a second slot at Science Lab III; the lab max level 4 since Session 6C (owner, Nov 18: Science Lab IV opens the Role Cores track), built from CC3. Session 6B finish (owner, Nov 17, 2026): costs 2/4/5/9 a track (80 parts in all); one EARNED research part a day per account (Lab store packs and the Lunar Pass are not limited); each Legendary set mod also has a free research path (30 of its track's part, 8 h) once Science Lab III stands and its track's set mod is researched; it is bought only after that set mod (Science Lab III alone never opens it); one of each part pack a UTC week. The Claude-invented tree target of 6-10 weeks was removed (it was never the owner's).

guards.what: CC timelines within ±10% of the audit table
no instant max-out: CC10 never inside the first week

cpSites.about: every line that adds to or takes from a pilot's CP (ledger.cp or ledger['cp'] with =, +=, -=, *=, /=, ++, --; .cp += / -= / ++ / --) and every debit( call. A new CP source or sink is an owner decision. Session 7 (owner brief Nov 21, 2026, decisions 6 and 10): Fortify's cost (decision 6), the war battles' spoils (decision 10) and the refund of a pilot's own Fortify spend when the territory falls before the job stands (a PROPOSAL: nothing is gained), in worker/src/conquest-war.js (a sector defense's pay moved there from conquest-campaign.js).

lint.about: code swallowed by a // comment never runs (the wall-storage bug, three dead test checks): none allowed

computed.about: owner-rules runs these guard tests itself and judges their own outputs against these limits, so loosening a test's asserts cannot pass

battalion.about: Session 6C (owner, Nov 18, 2026): Role Core levels 2-5 cost 2/4/5/9 command chips (chips and time only, never CP), 8 h jobs in the Science Lab's slots, opened by Science Lab IV; one EARNED command chip a UTC day per account (the chip pack is not limited); the chip pack one a UTC week; the first Science Lab grant: 2 parts of Thermal or Ballistics, once per account, outside the one-a-day part limit; allies never multiply points (a kill only allies damaged pays nothing); never sold: pilots, ranks, Role Core levels; command chips, recruits and liveries never award points; allies fielded: 1 with no Hangar, then 2/4/5/7/9 by Hangar level; a roster of 16.
